vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who makes coffee in a café
a small cup of very strong coffee
vocabulary.note_ar: لا يوجد حرف x فيها: espresso وليس expresso
vocabulary.example: He drinks an espresso after lunch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: espresso with a lot of hot milk
vocabulary.example: A latte is soft and milky.

vocabulary.meaning_en: espresso with hot milk and foam

vocabulary.example: Latte is a very popular drink.

vocabulary.meaning_en: Starbucks cup sizes, from smallest to largest
vocabulary.meaning_ar: أحجام الأكواب في ستاربكس من الأصغر إلى الأكبر
vocabulary.note_ar: Grande كلمة إيطالية تعني كبير، لكنها في ستاربكس حجم متوسط
vocabulary.note_en: These are Starbucks names; Grande is the middle-large size.
vocabulary.example: I'll go for a Grande, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one more small amount of espresso in your drink
vocabulary.example: Can I have an extra shot of espresso?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a taste added to a drink or food
a sweet brown flavor made from cooked sugar
vocabulary.example: She added caramel to her coffee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small round nut; also a coffee flavor

vocabulary.example: Your drink will be ready shortly.
I'll go for the large one.

fine_lines.title: Short / Tall / Grande / Venti vs small / medium / large
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في أغلب المقاهي نقول small / medium / large. في ستاربكس للأحجام أسماء خاصة: Short (صغير جدًا) ثم Tall ثم Grande ثم Venti (الأكبر). انتبه: Tall في ستاربكس ليس كبيرًا!
fine_lines.explanation_en: Most cafés use small, medium and large. Starbucks uses Short, Tall, Grande and Venti (biggest). Note: "Tall" is not big there!

examples.sentence: A Tall latte is a small-medium cup.
In most cafés, ask for a medium.

fine_lines.title: espresso vs Americano vs latte
fine_lines.explanation_ar: espresso قهوة قوية صغيرة. Americano إسبريسو مع ماء ساخن. latte إسبريسو مع حليب كثير.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Espresso is small and strong. An Americano is espresso with hot water. A latte is espresso with lots of milk.

examples.sentence: An Americano is like black coffee.
A latte has a lot of milk.

expressions.phrase: What can I get for you today?
expressions.meaning_en: The barista asks for your order.
expressions.example: Hi! What can I get for you today?

expressions.phrase: I'd like to have a coffee, please.
expressions.example: I'd like to have a tea, please.
We have tea and coffee. Which one would you like?
What size would you like? Tall, please.

expressions.phrase: I'll go for a Grande, please.
expressions.example: I'll go for a large, please.

expressions.phrase: Can I have an extra shot of espresso?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على جرعة إسبريسو إضافية؟
expressions.example: Can I have an extra shot, please?

expressions.phrase: Can I have your name, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني معرفة اسمك من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: The barista writes your name on the cup.
expressions.example: Can I have your name, please? Sure, it's Omar.

expressions.phrase: Your drink will be ready shortly.
expressions.example: Your coffee will be ready shortly.

grammar.title: Can I have ...? / I'd like ...
grammar.explanation_ar: لطلب شيء بأدب: Can I have + اسم + please? أو I'd like + اسم. وI'd like to have تعني أيضًا أريد.
grammar.explanation_en: To ask politely: "Can I have ... , please?" or "I'd like ...".
examples: Can I have a Grande latte, please?

grammar.title: Adjective order: size + hot/iced + drink
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الطلب نضع الحجم أولًا، ثم ساخن أو مثلج، ثم اسم المشروب.
grammar.explanation_en: When ordering, say the size first, then hot or iced, then the drink.

questions.question: Which Starbucks size is the biggest?
What is an Americano?
choices: coffee with a lot of milk
questions.explanation_en: An Americano is espresso with hot water.

questions.question: "I'll go for a Grande." "Go for" means ...
Choose the correct order:
questions.explanation_en: Size, then hot/iced, then the drink.

questions.question: "Your drink will be ready shortly." "Shortly" means ...
"Anything else for you today?" "____"
questions.explanation_en: The right answer is "No, that's all."

questions.question: Can I have an extra ____ of espresso?
questions.explanation_ar: نقول an extra shot of espresso.
questions.explanation_en: We say "an extra shot of espresso".
